title: First onboarding Help needs no agent session and attachments survive retry and reload with owner-only access
steps: Run tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-1779-first-chat-help.mjs with TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at an owned PostgreSQL database.
expect: Fresh authenticated email can ask and upload before an account exists; conversation GET creates nothing.
Onboarding composer sends Help without an agent session; allowed actions require a click.
Owner files persist, foreign reads and claims fail, cleanup retries failed deletes, and retry restores the completed answer for the original question.
